confidence_reasoning: Implemented all required scientific accuracy enhancements with comprehensive validation. Features work correctly and integrate seamlessly with existing codebase. High confidence based on thorough testing with real protein sequences.

work_completed.description: SCI-001: Fixed amino acid frequency inaccuracies with validated UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot data
work_completed.rationale: Original frequencies contained inaccuracies that compromised biological realism. Replaced with empirically validated frequencies from authoritative sources.
work_completed.verification: Cross-referenced with UniProtKB Release 2024_03, Kleczkowski et al., McCaldon & Argos, and Bogatyreva et al.
caveats: Frequencies are species-averaged and may not reflect tissue-specific or organism-specific patterns

work_completed.description: SCI-002: Implemented structure-aware negative sampling with biological constraints
work_completed.rationale: Simple random substitution ignored structural constraints and evolutionary patterns, reducing model robustness.
work_completed.verification: Added context-dependent destabilizing mutations based on Richardson (1981), MacArthur & Thornton (1991), and other authoritative sources.
caveats: Context prediction uses sequence-based heuristics rather than actual structural data

work_completed.description: SCI-003: Comprehensive biological plausibility validation for negative samples
work_completed.rationale: No validation existed for biologically impossible sequences, reducing model applicability to real proteins.
work_completed.verification: Implemented checks for hydrophobic/charged content, proline clusters, secondary structure compatibility, compositional bias.
caveats: Some specialized protein types (e.g., antimicrobial peptides) may trigger false positives

work_completed.rationale: Uniform mutation rates ignored evolutionary constraints and conservation patterns found in real proteins.
work_completed.verification: Functional amino acids show reduced mutation rates; position-specific conservation heuristics implemented.
caveats: True conservation requires multiple sequence alignments not available in this context

work_completed.description: SCI-005: Expanded negative sampling diversity strategies
work_completed.rationale: Limited to single substitution method, insufficient diversity for robust model training.
work_completed.verification: Implemented insertion/deletion, evolutionary drift, hydrophobic shuffle, and secondary structure disruption methods.
caveats: Some methods use simplified heuristics that could be enhanced with more sophisticated algorithms

work_completed.description: Enhanced test suite for scientific accuracy validation
work_completed.rationale: Needed comprehensive testing to validate all scientific accuracy improvements.
work_completed.verification: Tests include real protein sequences, edge cases, and integration validation.
caveats: Test proteins are from common families; rare protein types may need additional validation

issues_encountered.description: Conservation-aware mutation rates increase variance in actual mutation rates
issues_encountered.impact: Required adjustment of mutation rate tolerance from 2% to 5% to accommodate scientifically realistic variation
issues_encountered.workaround: Adjusted tolerance parameters and updated tests
issues_encountered.location: mutation rate validation in tests and dataset

issues_encountered.description: Secondary structure disruption method initially too aggressive
issues_encountered.impact: Generated sequences that failed biological plausibility checks
issues_encountered.workaround: Reduced disruption intensity from 0.7 to 0.3 to maintain plausibility

potential_future_issues.concern: Sequence-based context prediction may miss important structural details
potential_future_issues.mitigation: Integration with AlphaFold or ESMFold predictions would improve accuracy
potential_future_issues.context: Current heuristics work well but lack true 3D structural information

potential_future_issues.concern: Conservation heuristics may not capture family-specific patterns
potential_future_issues.mitigation: Could add protein family classification and family-specific conservation patterns
potential_future_issues.context: Current approach uses general principles rather than family-specific knowledge
